sources.entry: Talkyard - Create a community, where your users can suggest ideas and get questions answered. And have friendly open-ended discussions and chat (Slack/StackOverflow/Discourse/Reddit/Disqus hybrid). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Scala

summary.one_liner: Talkyard is self-hostable forum software that combines threaded discussions, Q&A, idea voting, anonymous comments, simple chat channels, and blog comments.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes forum software with threaded comments where insightful replies rise to the top and users can sort by votes. It supports question-and-answer threads where a discussion can have a selected answer, and upvoting of ideas. Users can post anonymously, for example for embarrassing questions or anonymous feedback. Tags can carry values, so topics can be listed and sorted by a tag value such as priority. It also includes basic chat channels, with email notifications noted as the current option, and can be used as a blog comment system configured in the Admin Area under Embedded Comments. The README gives a demo, a discussion forum, and development docs in docs/developing-talkyard.md, and points to a separate talkyard-prod-one repo for self-hosting.
use_cases: run a community forum with idea voting
question and answer discussions with accepted answers
replace Disqus-style blog comments without ads or tracking
tag and sort topics by priority values
how_to_run: See talkyard-prod-one for self-hosting instructions (referenced in README)
For development, see docs/developing-talkyard.md in this repo
notable: Anonymous comments for embarrassing questions or anonymous feedback
Tags with values that can be listed and sorted
Blog comments positioned as a Disqus alternative with no ads or tracking
Question-answer threads with a selectable answer and a Disagree button
caveats: Chat features are described as pretty basic
Chat notifications are via email only, as of now
